lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in structured vertical columns of approximately 5-6 units posterior to the gill slits, transitioning to a staggered grid-like arrangement along the mid-lateral flank with horizontal spacing roughly 1.5 times the vertical spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontal luminance gradients, with primary white blobs functioning as anchor nodes at these grid-like intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank; the primary ridge displays a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal edge and deep shadow on the ventral edge, following a linear horizontal trajectory.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of approximately 10-12 high-luminance blobs, with a higher concentration observed towards the posterior and distal regions of the fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The trailing edge of the left pectoral fin exhibits multiple deep, irregular serrated notches and localized tissue loss, consistent with mechanical trauma or past entanglement.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple remoras (Echeneidae) attached to the ventral-lateral surface, including one distinct individual near the axillary region of the pectoral fin.
